import Analysis.AnalyticFunction
import MeasureTheory.Measure
import ProbabilityTheory.CumulantGeneratingFunction

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} : 
  AnalyticOn ℝ (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) (interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) := by
  let f := λ λ : ℝ, log (∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ)
  let S := integrableExpSet X μ
  let U := interior S

  -- Step 1: Show that the set where exp(λX) is integrable is open
  have h_open_S : IsOpen S := is_open_integrable_exp_set m

  -- Step 2: Show that the map λ ↦ E[exp(λX)] is smooth on the interior
  have h_smooth_expected_exp : ∀ λ ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ ℝ (λ ↦ ∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ) := by
    intro λ hλ
    have h_integrable : Integrable (exp ∘ (λ * X)) μ := by
      rw [integrable_exp_iff]
      exact hλ
    have h_continuous : Continuous (λ ↦ ∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ) := by
      apply continuous_integral
      exact continuous_on_mul_right (Continuous.const_smul _ (Continuous.id _))
      exact continuous_on_exp (continuous_on_const.const_mul continuous_id)
      exact measurable_on_mul_right (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
      exact measurable_on_exp measurable_const
    have h_differentiable : DifferentiableAt ℝ ℝ (λ ↦ ∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ) :=
      by
        apply differentiable_at_integral
        exact h_integrable
        exact h_continuous
        intro λ'
        have h_integrable' : Integrable (exp ∘ (λ' * X)) μ := by
          rw [integrable_exp_iff]
          exact hλ
        have h_continuous' : Continuous (λ ↦ ∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ) := by
          apply continuous_integral
          exact continuous_on_mul_right (Continuous.const_smul _ (Continuous.id _))
          exact continuous_on_exp (continuous_on_const.const_mul continuous_id)
          exact measurable_on_mul_right (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
          exact measurable_on_exp measurable_const
        have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ℝ (λ ↦ ∫ Ω exp (λ * X ω) μ) :=
          by
            apply differentiable_at_integral
            exact h_integrable'
            exact h_continuous'
        exact h_diff
    exact h_differentiable

  -- Step 3: Show that the logarithm is analytic on the image of the expectation map
  have h_log_analytic : ∀ y > 0, AnalyticAt ℝ (λ ↦ log y) y := by
    intro y h_pos
    have h_cont : Continuous (λ ↦ log y) := by
      exact continuous_const
    have h_diff : ∀ λ, DifferentiableAt ℝ ℝ (λ ↦ log y) := by
      intro λ
      exact differentiable_at_const
    have h_analytic : AnalyticAt ℝ (λ ↦ log y) y :=
      by
        constructor
        exact h_cont
        exact h_diff
    exact h_analytic

  -- Step 4: Combine results to show that the CGF is analytic
  have h_cgf_analytic : AnalyticOn ℝ f U := by
    apply analytic_on_log_of_analytic_on_exp
    exact h_open_S
    exact h_smooth_expected_exp
    exact h_log_analytic

  exact h_cgf_analytic
